thread:
maya_cs: heads up — Peregrine Labs just tripped our spend anomaly for hosted API. Usage jumped to ~1.8M tokens this week vs their commit of 1.1M. Forecast shows ~2.6x overcommit by month-end :chart_with_upwards_trend:

ops-bot: automated alert: customer=peregrine-labs event=spend_anomaly score=0.87 window=7d details=/alerts/1772345600

derek_csm: who was last working with them on onboarding? is this expected because of the new rerank pipeline? :thinking_face:

olivia_ce: ping — we rolled enablement guide v2 last week. They were testing batch reranks. I see many long-context requests (seq len 8k+) + high concurrency.

jordan_eng: checked the infra logs — a burst of retries between 02:10–02:25 UTC due to transient 503s. A few clients retried aggressively, doubling token usage for some calls. snippet of query: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE customer='peregrine-labs' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-04T02:10Z' AND '2026-03-04T02:25Z';
```

tony_fin: financial flag: if this continues they'll blow past monthly committed spend. Recommend temporary token cap and notify them of potential overage.

maya_cs: proposed immediate actions: 1) apply soft cap at 1.5M tokens for the account (temp) 2) reach out to Peregrine AM + share retry guidance 3) open engineering ticket to investigate retry pattern. assigning: @derek_csm to customer comms, @jordan_eng to infra ticket, @olivia_ce to enablement doc.

derek_csm: will draft customer note now — short + actionable. plan to offer a quick sync with AM tomorrow.

jordan_eng: created ENG ticket INF-4293. root cause hypothesis = client-side exponential retry + occasional 503s from edge. I'll throttle at the gateway for that tenant for 24h and monitor.

olivia_ce: I'll add a 1-page best-practices snippet about retry backoff + bundling for reranks. link to draft: https://confluence.redwood/peregrine-rerank-retries

maya_cs: thanks team. tony — can you pre-approve a one-time credit if we need to smooth renewal discussions?

tony_fin: tentatively yes up to $5k credit, please include expected mitigation timeline and commit to follow-up.

ops-bot: billing projection update: new forecast for peregrine-labs = $14.2k/mo (commit billed = $6.0k/mo) — variance reason: high token rate, seq-length multiplier.

maya_cs: next steps: 1) derek send note within 60m 2) jordan apply throttle + post status in this thread 3) olivia publish retry guidance 4) maya to run weekly spend report and flag if >1.25x commit.

derek_csm: note sent to AM & technical contact (cc: olivia) — asked them to confirm any recent SDK changes. copy of message: "We noticed an unusual spike and temporarily applied a soft cap to avoid surprise overage. Can we do a 15-min sync?" :email:

jordan_eng: throttle applied at 02:45 UTC. initial effect: 35% reduction in token rate. monitoring. :eyes:

maya_cs: perfect. I'll follow up in tomorrow's account health check and include adjusted forecast. closing loop later today. :white_check_mark:
